description: Defines the canonical multidimensional context model used by A.R.I.A. to determine applicability, specificity, inheritance, retrieval relevance, experience scope, probability scope, and technical reasoning boundaries.

core_principle.statement: ARIA shall represent context as an intersecting set of independent dimensions rather than as a hierarchical directory path. Knowledge, evidence, experience, hypotheses, actions, and relationships may apply across any combination of dimensions.
rules: Context dimensions shall remain independently addressable.
No single dimension shall define the complete technical context.
Unknown dimensions shall not prevent use of otherwise applicable broader knowledge.
More specific applicable information shall normally outrank broader information.
Specific information shall not automatically override broader information when its authority or evidence quality is weaker.
User identity shall be a context dimension without becoming part of canonical technical truth.
Manufacturer and product shall not contain scope, technology, or failure mode hierarchies.
Context shall be extensible without restructuring existing knowledge.
Context matching shall support partial matches.
Contradictory information shall be evaluated using specificity, authority, temporal applicability, and evidence quality.

dimensions.description: Organization associated with the case, experience, user, or technical environment.
Customer or carrier context applicable to the information.
Project-specific context.
Diagnostic case-specific context.
User-specific experience or interaction context.
Equipment manufacturer.
Manufacturer product family.
Canonical product.
Specific product variant.
Technologies active or applicable within the context.
Work activities or operational scopes applicable to the information.
Specific physical site.
Logical role of the site within the system or path.
Specific communications or RF path.
Logical role within a path or topology.
Specific components relevant to the context.
Functional roles such as MAIN_RADIO, DIVERSITY_RADIO, OCM_MAIN, OCM_DIVERSITY, ANTENNA, FLEX_TWIST, or MODEM.
Applicable RF frequency band.
Applicable channel, center frequency, or channel identifier.
Applicable polarization or polarization relationship.
Applicable topology concepts such as 1+0, 2+0, XPIC, Space Diversity, ring, protected, or unprotected.
Hardware revision when behavior is revision-specific.
Software release relevant to technical behavior.
Firmware revision relevant to technical behavior.
Applicable configuration profiles, modes, or roles.
Weather and environmental conditions relevant to the technical state.
Operational network condition during observation or reasoning.
Service availability or degradation state.
Time interval or lifecycle period during which the context applies.
Geographic context when technically relevant.

rules: Product hierarchy may be used for applicability inheritance.
Product hierarchy shall not become the primary storage hierarchy for technical knowledge.
Knowledge applicable to UBT-T may apply to UBT-T 18 GHz unless explicitly constrained or contradicted.
Variant-specific information may narrow or override broader applicability when sufficiently authoritative.
One case may have multiple active scopes.
Technical knowledge may apply across multiple scopes.
Scope shall not be inferred solely from product or manufacturer.
Troubleshooting knowledge may reference installation knowledge without duplicating it.
Technologies may overlap.
Products may support multiple technologies.
A technical concept may apply to multiple products from multiple manufacturers through shared technology context.

role_context.description: Logical component and endpoint roles shall be represented independently of physical model numbers.
role_context.rule: ARIA shall reason about functional roles even when the specific physical component identity is unknown.

rules: Environmental conditions shall be considered only when technically relevant.
Weather correlation shall not automatically establish weather causation.
Observation time shall accompany time-sensitive environmental evidence.

context_specificity.description: Measures how narrowly information is scoped relative to the active case.

conceptual_levels.name: CASE
conceptual_levels.example: Current Site B Radio B state

rules: Specificity is multidimensional and shall not be calculated from directory depth.
A user-specific record is not automatically technically more authoritative than manufacturer documentation.
Specificity influences relevance but does not independently determine truth.
Exact matches shall generally score higher than inherited matches.
Compatible broader context may remain applicable.
Unknown active-case dimensions shall not be treated as conflicts.
Explicitly incompatible dimensions may exclude a record.
Context match shall be combined with authority, evidence quality, confidence, and recency.
The formula shall remain configurable.
Not all dimensions require equal weight.
Dimensions material to the current technical question may receive greater weight.
A product mismatch may be critical for product-specific configuration while irrelevant for a universal RF principle.
Broader knowledge may flow into narrower context when no incompatible constraint exists.
Narrower knowledge shall not automatically flow outward into broader contexts.
Manufacturer-specific knowledge shall not automatically apply to other manufacturers.
Technology-level knowledge may apply across manufacturers when the underlying technical principle is shared.
Product-specific procedures shall remain product-specific unless generalized through validated evidence or governance.
User experience shall never be inherited by another user.
Specificity alone shall not resolve a contradiction.
Current direct evidence may outweigh historical generalized experience.
Authoritative product documentation may outweigh generalized practice when applicable.
Observed field behavior may create a contradiction requiring investigation rather than silent replacement of authoritative knowledge.

user_context.description: Defines how user-specific history participates in multidimensional context.
user_context.rule: User context personalizes reasoning strategy without personalizing technical reality.

experience_scope.description: Experience shall be tagged with the dimensions that were actually present when the outcome occurred.
rules: Experience shall not automatically generalize beyond its validated scope.
ARIA may use broader aggregates when narrow sample sizes are insufficient.
The scope used for a probability adjustment shall remain explainable.

progressive_generalization.description: Allows ARIA to widen historical retrieval when exact context contains insufficient data.
example_order: Clayton + Nokia + UBT-T + 18 GHz + Space Diversity + RSL discrepancy
Clayton + Nokia + UBT-T + Space Diversity + RSL discrepancy
All users + Nokia + UBT-T + Space Diversity + RSL discrepancy
All validated microwave RSL discrepancy cases
rules: ARIA shall prefer the most specific statistically useful experience scope.
Scope widening shall be explicit internally.
Broader data shall not masquerade as user-specific history.
Sample size and calibration shall influence how strongly historical experience modifies priors.

context_signature.description: Canonical normalized representation used for matching, caching, retrieval, experience aggregation, and reasoning.
context_signature.rule: The signature identifies contextual equivalence for computation; it does not replace the underlying structured context object.

rules: Retrieval shall not rely primarily on file paths.
Canonical graph relationships and context metadata shall drive retrieval.
Broad knowledge may be retrieved alongside narrow knowledge when diagnostically useful.
Duplicate semantic information shall be consolidated before model context assembly where practical.

retrieved_knowledge.knowledge: RSL may degrade due to alignment error.
Space Diversity requires correct Main/Diversity RF routing.
Clayton has 9 validated configuration errors across 13 comparable cases.

example.interpretation: ARIA can combine universal RF knowledge, technology knowledge, Nokia product knowledge, and Clayton-specific experience without storing four copies of RSL degradation.

semantic_rules.rule: Context shall be represented as independent intersecting dimensions rather than directory hierarchy.
No single dimension shall define complete technical applicability.
Unknown dimensions shall remain unknown rather than becoming mismatches.
Context matching shall support partial applicability.
More-specific applicable information shall generally receive greater relevance.
Specificity shall not independently determine authority or correctness.
Broader technical knowledge may inherit downward into compatible narrower context.
Narrow context shall not automatically generalize outward.
Technology knowledge may cross manufacturer boundaries when technically universal.
Manufacturer-specific behavior shall remain manufacturer constrained.
Product-specific behavior shall remain product constrained unless validated generalization occurs.
User experience shall never be inherited by another user.
User context may alter reasoning strategy but shall not alter technical truth.
Experience shall retain the context in which it was observed.
Historical retrieval shall prefer the most specific statistically useful scope.
ARIA may progressively generalize retrieval when narrow experience is insufficient.
Broader historical data shall remain distinguishable from user-specific data.
Functional roles shall remain distinguishable from physical equipment identities.
Context signatures shall support computation and retrieval without replacing structured context.
Adding a new context dimension shall not require restructuring ARIA's existing knowledge graph.
